Production code has zero references to SDK private tool registries
MCP 2025-11-25 initialize, tools/list and tools/call integration paths pass
OAuth consent identifies the ToolSpan instance, client, redirect origin and requested scopes

offline_access metadata and refresh-token rotation preserve but never expand Tool permissions
The packed production artifact runs compiled password, doctor, start and health paths
Deterministic source verification is separated from installed runtime preflight
Existing path, origin, OAuth, runner and process safety boundaries remain enforced
English and Chinese documentation explain local versus remote tools, workflows and safety
ChatGPT Chat versus Codex usage content is generated from a schema-valid snapshot with stale fallback
Open-source foundation files are complete and contain no invented maintainer identity
Core CI is parseable, SHA-pinned and uses least privilege without unsafe pull_request_target or public self-hosted jobs
Desktop has an independent package and lockfile and Core install does not pull GUI dependencies
Protocol v1 schema, hello fixture, recovery and host integration are deterministic
Desktop adds no public Admin route, arbitrary shell, MCP client, gateway or Agent Runtime
Node discovery validates configured, PATH, common-install and manual-selection candidates
Owned child lifecycle uses a nonce and never kills an unknown or external process
First run writes validated config atomically with conflict detection, rollback and bounded backups
Password hashing occurs in Rust and plaintext never enters Node protocol, persistence or diagnostics
Onboarding, Overview and Connection render real recoverable runtime state
Allowed roots, jobs, artifacts and sanitized logs preserve confirmations and safety boundaries
Tray actions are bounded and respect owned versus external Core lifecycle
English and zh-CN locale trees have zero missing keys
Light, Dark and System themes are implemented and tested
Critical pages have zero serious or critical axe findings
Desktop changes preserve deterministic Core headless verification and packed-release smoke

requirements.summary: Only one applying or rolling-back setup session may hold the versioned process-aware lock
Versioned setup state and journal force crash recovery through reconciliation rather than an automatic write
Cloudflare management credentials are session-only and absent from persistence, logs and diagnostics
Tunnel runtime credentials remain inside the official cloudflared mechanism and never enter ToolSpan persistence or command lines
The complete guided manual flow works without giving ToolSpan a Cloudflare management credential
A missing or pending Cloudflare zone blocks Apply and routes to registrar nameserver onboarding until Active
The scoped-token path performs verify, dry run, confirmation, apply and deterministic verification
A second setup run reuses proven resources and creates zero duplicates
Rollback is owned-only, fingerprint-guarded and truthfully reports full, partial and credential-reentry outcomes
The dated ChatGPT guide provides copy materials and never treats user confirmation as host validation
The safe manifest and Prompt Pack expose only approved fields and all six human checkpoints
Existing-domain, any-registrar and no-referral paths remain equally available
No-referral path contains no referral parameter or coupon attribution
Stale offers hide price and coupon claims without dark patterns, auto-open, auto-copy or click telemetry
Verified vendor assets are optional and missing assets produce a safe text-only fallback
Setup networking enforces fixed origins, configured HTTPS targets and bounded redirect, scheme, private-address and response rules
Setup receipts and diagnostics contain non-secret evidence and zero credentials, passwords or hashes
The local Cloudflare mock covers contract, retry, conflict, idempotency and redaction scenarios with zero CI secrets
The external test manifest contains only flags, IDs and secret environment-variable names; missing capabilities remain blockers
The packed source contains required Setup docs, prompts, schemas and snapshots but no runtime state or secrets
MCP Inspector validates initialize, exact 27 tools, read, authorized mutation and insufficient-scope behavior
